verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack documents user controls for data retention or deletion, such as retention settings, session or history deletion, account or data deletion, or zero-retention modes. The only related item is a probe noting a "data-handling policy" listed in llms.txt, with no content about user-controllable retention or deletion. Bringing your own or self-hosted models is an adjacent workaround, not a retention control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
